papers.title: Explicit Layer Modeling for Video Object Insertion and Layer Decomposition
papers.abstract: Abstract  Most video editing systems still lack explicit layered video representations, limiting their ability to perform realistic compositing, object reuse, and consistent manipulation. This limitation is especially pronounced in video object insertion and video layer decomposition, where existing methods rely on implicit inference or per-scene optimization due to the absence of explicit foreground-layer supervision. We introduce TriLayer, a large-scale triplet video dataset containing aligned composite, background, and foreground videos, where the foreground layers include both object appearance and associated visual effects. This explicit supervision enables models to learn layered video representations directly rather than inferring them implicitly. Building on this dataset, we propose DBL-Diffusion, a dual-branch diffusion framework that jointly models RGB composites and RGBA foreground layers through shared denoising and cross-branch interaction. We instantiate the framework in two tasks: DBL-Insert for layered object insertion, which generates explicit RGBA layers for realistic compositing and flexible post-editing, and DBL-Decompose for video layer decomposition, which recovers foreground and background layers using triplet supervision. Experiments demonstrate that explicit layer modeling substantially improves both insertion fidelity and decomposition quality.

ru.title: Явное моделирование слоев для реалистичного видеомонтажа
ru.desc: В данной статье представлен метод TriLayer, который предлагает явные слоистые представления видео для улучшения видеомонтажа. Он использует большое количество данных, состоящих из композитных, фоновый и передних слоев видео с визуальными эффектами. Это позволяет моделям обучаться явным слоистым представлениям видео, а не полагаться на неявное извлечение информации. Приложенные задачи DBL-Insert и DBL-Decompose значительно улучшают качество вставки объектов и разложения слоев видео.

en.title: Revolutionizing Video Editing with Explicit Layer Modeling
en.desc: This paper addresses the limitations of current video editing systems that do not use explicit layered video representations. It introduces TriLayer, a large dataset that provides aligned composite, background, and foreground videos, allowing for better supervision in video editing tasks. The authors propose a dual-branch diffusion framework called DBL-Diffusion, which effectively models RGB composites and RGBA foreground layers. Their experiments show that using explicit layer modeling significantly enhances the quality of object insertion and video layer decomposition.

papers.title: GPT-Red: Automated Red Teaming via Self-Play at Scale
papers.abstract: Abstract  We introduce GPT-Red, an automated red-teaming agent that is trained to discover novel prompt injection attacks against frontier LLMs. The goal of this model is to evaluate and improve the robustness of our production systems. To this end, we use it to adversarially train GPT-5.6, our most robust model to prompt injections to date. To create GPT-Red, we design a scalable self-play algorithm where the model is tasked with attacking a diverse population of simultaneously-trained defender agents. We train the model on realistic red-teaming environments using compute on the same scale as some of our largest RL post-training runs, making it the single-largest LLM safety training run ever documented. GPT-Red excels at red-teaming: it reliably breaks our past models up to GPT-5.5, it finds more successful attacks than human red-teamers, and it generalizes to held-out environments, defender models, and harnesses. In the future, we expect that as we improve the robustness of each new GPT model, it will in turn will provide better learning signal for even stronger red-teamer agents, thus unlocking a self-improvement flywheel.

ru.title: Новая эпоха защиты LLM с GPT-Red
ru.desc: В статье представлен GPT-Red, автоматизированный агент для обнаружения новых атак через инъекции подсказок против современных LLM. Модель оценивает и улучшает надежность производственных систем, занимаясь противостоянием по обучению с использованием GPT-5.6. GPT-Red использует масштабируемый алгоритм самоигры, где он атакует различных защитников, что делает его крупнейшим проектом по обучению безопасности LLM. Эта модель превосходит человеческие команды в нахождении успешных атак и демонстрирует способность к обобщению на новых средах.

en.title: Revolutionizing LLM Security with GPT-Red
en.desc: The paper presents GPT-Red, an automated agent designed to identify new prompt injection attacks on advanced large language models (LLMs). Its primary purpose is to enhance the security and robustness of production systems by adversarially training the latest model, GPT-5.6. GPT-Red employs a self-play algorithm to simulate attacks against multiple defender agents, making it the largest safety training run for LLMs documented to date. The results show that GPT-Red outperforms human red-teamers in discovering successful attacks and demonstrates strong generalization capabilities across different environments and models.
